description: A figure with a human body in a loose tunic but a donkey's head, long ears and brown muzzle, reclines on a bed in a dim, cluttered room. He reaches a hoof-like hand toward a tipped-over terracotta jar whose liquid spills across a wooden table, beside a lit clay oil lamp with smoke rising. Behind are hanging cloth, a wooden bed frame and a stool holding a rolled scroll. Dark oil-painting style, filling the image edge to edge, with no visible text.
